question: Why must the god explain the matter to his devoted attendants?
premises: The speakers urgently request an explanation.
The addressed deity is the one capable of explaining.
The speakers identify themselves as the deity's servants.
inference: Because the speakers are devoted servants of the god, they are entitled to receive his explanation.
uncertainties: The exact nuance distinguishing kathyataṃ and kathyatāṃ is not fully certain beyond emphatic repetition.
plain_english: Tell, tell, O god, because we are your servants.
